links.outcome: Report usability and usefulness after iterative clinician interview feedback across five report versions
links.effect: 19 of 34 clinicians interviewed; feedback produced 5 report versions with fewer revisions each time; predictive scores useful to most practitioners (83%).
links.quote: The usefulness and usability of the DA report has improved through user feedback; both barriers and drivers to implementation exist.

unlisted_practices: Noninterventional real-time deployment with reports shown only after donation completed, to test feasibility of report generation

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility, real-time generation (silent/non-interventional mode), and user feedback/optimization of an AI decision support tool for organ donation.
